vovikus.retinal_images.description: Fundus photos as taken (no preparation needed).
vovikus.positive_threshold.description: Probability from which glaucoma / atrophy is reported as found.

vovikus.valid_threshold.description: A candidate is accepted as the optic disc when the classifier's valid_image is at least this.

vovikus.retinal_classify_result.descript: Per photo: status, chosen disc, probabilities, all candidates, timing.
